issue: PMAT-566 (closes forjar#566) — msrv.yml's `rustup override set 1.89.0` left a persistent directory override in reused runner workspaces, outranking rust-toolchain.toml, so every later forjar job on that runner silently ran 1.89.0 instead of the pinned 1.93.0. Two symptoms, both first diagnosed as something else: lint (#567, no clippy on 1.89.0) and mutation (#566, cargo-mutants 27.1.0 needs 1.91). The MSRV is now selected per job with RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN. BATCHED: this branch also carries PMAT-601 (the v1.32.0 impl receipts, formerly PR #602, closed unmerged), folded in so a saturated fleet runs one CI instead of two. That content was reviewed by its own quorum — .quorum/PMAT-601-impl-receipts-v1.32.0.json and .quorum/evidence/PMAT-601-*.md, committed here — and is unchanged apart from a note in impl-PMAT-601-receipt.md recording the batch.

systems: Nix: the toolchain is part of a derivation's input closure, so a build cannot inherit one from ambient state in a directory [X] — the defect cannot occur by construction
Bazel: toolchains are resolved per target from declared constraints, not from state left in the workspace by a previous action [X]
Docker: a job in a fresh container starts from the image, so nothing one job leaves behind reaches the next [X] — which is why the ephemeral eph-build runners never showed this
